title: Argentinian Velvety Stew
description:
A hearty and comforting stew made with Argentinian beef, 
   but adapted for a vegetarian diet, this recipe replaces beef with 
   portobello mushrooms, maintaining the same rich flavor profile.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chili flakes, tomato paste, beef broth, red wine, and kissed tomatoes. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
